decision_conditions: Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 4 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
Condition : 6 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.

Condition : 7 - No advertisment shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder, the ready interpretation of any road sign, railway sign or aid to navigation by water or air so as to otherwise render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway ( including any coastal waters) or aerodrome (civil or military).

Condition : 8 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority
description: Installation of 1 x 8m high flagpole 1 x single sided internally illuminated wall star, 1 x internally illuminated fascia sign  (810mmx 6000mm), 1 x internally illuminated fascia sign (810mm x 4000mm), 3 x wall mounted customer parking signs (1220mm x 280mm)nd 1 x single sided wall mounted reception signs(1220mm x 280mm) to site.
